explication: Valkey is a high-performance key/value data-structure server. The principal workflow is: a client sends a RESP command, networking parses it, command dispatch performs authorization and execution against native data structures, then a reply returns through the connection. The server also supports persistence, replication, clustering, Sentinel, scripting, modules, TLS, and experimental RDMA. Sampled source confirms the scripting-manager/Lua-engine boundary; several other subsystem links are based on the documented product structure and exact tree paths.
